# Operator spacing

Binary and relational operators get spaced: $a + b$, $a <= b$, and
$\alpha + \beta$. A unary minus stays tight: $-x$ and $f(-x)$. Command operators
get spaced too: $a \cdot b$ and $x \leq y$.

A starred command modifier stays tight: $\operatorname*{minimize} a$.

$$
  x = -y
$$

$$
  \operatorname*{minimize} a
$$
